status: unreleased SDK projection of the existing public Engine tool boundary

transport.authentication: bearer header; no credential in URL, body or errors
transport.tls: required except explicitly opted-in literal loopback HTTP

request.name: ctx_read

arguments.path: one non-empty UTF-8 host-relative or absolute path

request.path_controls: reject Unicode Cc, including NUL, DEL and C1

response.content: exactly one text block; valid UTF-8
response.isError: absent, null or false; true and other types rejected

receipt_metadata.receipt_id: 1..512 printable ASCII bytes; distinct from artifact digest
receipt_metadata.receipt_ref: id: followed by the exact receipt_digest

authority_limits: Host owns path policy and signer configuration; SDK supplies neither.
No invented tenant prerequisite or response tenant-binding guarantee.
Receipt metadata is not signed receipt bytes or cryptographic verification.
A delivered context view is not an accepted task outcome.
